fields.name: NODE_ENV
fields.doc: development, test or production (unset, development): the first two fill unset variables with their local values, production none; the images set production

fields.name: PORT
fields.doc: The port ID listens on

fields.name: ID_HOST
fields.doc: The address to listen on: loopback unless a container or a proxy in front needs another

fields.name: DATABASE_URL

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
fields.doc: ID's origin: the issuer, the pages' origin and the base of the admin API's audience

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
fields.doc: The application secret, at least 32 characters: signs cookies and encrypts what ID stores

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS
fields.doc: The rotation ring, version:secret pairs separated by commas: the first writes, every one decrypts

fields.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
fields.doc: The Google platform application's client ID; set it with GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET or leave both unset

fields.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET

fields.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID

fields.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.doc: The Entra platform application's client secret

fields.name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
fields.doc: Origins trusted besides ID's own, separated by commas: browser origins and identity-provider endpoints; production requires them

fields.name: ROOT_ADMIN_SECRET
fields.doc: The root bearer, at least 32 characters, for the first run; it stops working once a person holds platform:write

fields.name: ROOT_ADMIN_BREAK_GLASS
fields.doc: true keeps the root bearer working after a person holds platform:write; for break-glass only

fields.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
fields.doc: The ingress proxies' networks, IPv4 or IPv6, separated by commas; production requires them

fields.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX
fields.doc: Connections per process; size it with docs/06's formula against the database's limit

fields.doc: bootstrap: the managed database's administrative login (CREATEDB and CREATEROLE), a URL with sslmode=verify-full

fields.doc: register and make-admin: ID's root secret, ROOT_ADMIN_SECRET; make-admin requires it, and register mints its own client with it when ops-id-client is empty

fields.doc: register: the port of Claude Code's OAuth callback, --callback-port, that the host clients allow

fields.doc: register: the Deployments to start once their client secrets exist, name=replicas separated by commas

fields.doc: register: the staff directory's Entra tenant ID, a GUID, with OPS_STAFF_DOMAIN

fields.doc: The shared MCP database, answerable_mcps, as a superuser of the development Postgres: bun mcp db migrate provisions and migrates an MCP's local schema there, and an own MCP's database beside it

fields.name: MCP_DEV_ID_CLIENT_ID
fields.doc: bun mcp's machine client in your local ID, mcp-dev, through which bun mcp dev registers an MCP and its servers read who is calling; bun mcp setup makes it and writes this

fields.name: MCP_DEV_ID_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.doc: mcp-dev's secret, which ID shows once; bun mcp setup writes it

fields.name: MCP_DEV_ORGANISATION
fields.doc: The slug of the organisation bun mcp dev gives access to the MCP it runs, so that you can call every tool: your local ID's platform organisation unless bun mcp setup --organisation says another

fields.name: ROOT_ADMIN_SECRET
fields.doc: ID's root bearer, which bun mcp setup uses while ID's root is unlocked: ID's own local default unless .env sets another
